You are a RUNNER for one billed smoke run in freytag-forge. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. This spends about two cents expected, nine cents at most on the project's Cloudflare Workers AI account and the human has approved it (30 calls to Llama 3.3 70B fp8-fast with JSON mode off and default sampling, two prompt arms of 15 calls each, ceiling $0.09, expected about $0.02). HARD RULES: run the two commands below EXACTLY ONCE, in order. NEVER run the first command a second time for any reason (not after an error, not after a partial result: a rerun would spend money again). Do not edit any file. Do not print, echo, cat or log environment variables or the .env file or any credential. Do not git commit.

COMMAND 1 (the billed run; non-zero exit with partial rows is a valid outcome, do not retry):
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && (set -a; . ./.env; set +a; unset OPENAI_API_KEY RAILWAY_TOKEN RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID FREYTAG_TEST_CLOCK_TOKEN; .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py --prompts bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-probe-prompts.json --variants llama-3.3-70b-default-temp --slots confirm --run --confirm --max-calls 30 --max-usd 0.09 --out bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-confirm-rows.json)

COMMAND 2 (renders the report; safe to rerun if it fails):
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp && .venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py --report --rows bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-confirm-rows.json --out bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-confirm-report.md

Then print the per-variant summary section of bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-confirm-report.md (usable count, latency min/median/max, tokens, cost, any error text) and say in one or two sentences what happened, including any stop reason. Do not interpret quality; just report.

doc=json.load(open('bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-confirm-rows.json'))
rows=doc['rows'] if isinstance(doc,dict) and 'rows' in doc else doc
